title: Mac Resolution Fix
description: Fixes the EXTREMELY annoying bug (especially with sodium) where if we press F11 or exit and reenter the full screen mode on latest versions, the custom resolution gets reset to retina full resolution.
body:
**This mod fixes the extremely annoying bug with the full screen exclusive resolution setting, especially with sodium.** Without this mod, if we exit and re-enter the full screen mode (F11) on a MacOS device, the custom resolution gets reset to the incredibly high retina resolution tanking the fps and not respecting user setting unless we go manually into settings and change it up again. This mod fixes this issue entirely, whether after opening or using F11 to full screen, this mod makes it so that the custom resolution is always used and applied. Have fun :]
